title: SpaceX Just Bought 2 Million Nvidia GPUs and Nobody Noticed
description:
SpaceX is buying 2 million Nvidia Rubin GPUs 🚀 on top of the 540k they already own. Their cluster jumps from 1.4 to 10 gigawatts by end of 2027, thats a 5x leap. The AI arm already pulls $2.5B per quater, mostly renting out compute 🔥 At this scale raw compute starts mattering more than how clever your model is ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
